module: "Progress" tab (progress configuration) of the mission editor. It gets the mission type's progress definition (gameplay_missions_missions.getMissionProgressSetupData) and offers a "Raw" mode to edit the saveData JSON. The module returns a constructor: require(...)(missionEditor). File apparently incomplete.
notes: Bug: draw calls self:drawProgress(), which is not defined in this file (copy of progressSingle); outside Raw mode, the call causes a Lua error.
Bug: self.missionInstance is never set in setMission, while Raw mode reads self.missionInstance.saveData.
Raw mode displays missionInstance.saveData but writes the result into mission.saveData.

C.desc: Instance of the tab. Fields: missionEditor, mission, progressSetup, rawEditPerMission.

setMission.desc: Sets the current mission and loads progressSetup for its type.

draw.desc: Draws the header with the Raw checkbox then the progress view or the raw JSON editor (Edit / Finish Editing / Cancel).
